question: The disintegration of the Bahamani Empire gave rise to ________ independent kingdoms in Deccan.
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The disintegration of the Bahamani Empire in the late 15th century led to the rise of five independent kingdoms in the Deccan region.
 
• These kingdoms were Bijapur, Golkonda, Ahmadnagar, Bidar, and Berar.
 
• The Bahamani Empire had been established in the mid-14th century but began to weaken due to internal conflicts and external pressures.
 
• The process of disintegration began around 1518 and was complete by 1527 when these five kingdoms emerged.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bijapur:** It was one of the most prominent successor states, known for its architectural contributions like the Gol Gumbaz.
 
• **Golkonda:** Famous for its diamond mines and strong fortifications, it later became a part of the Mughal Empire.
 
• **Ahmadnagar:** Known for its strong military and strategic importance, it was founded by Malik Ahmad Nizam Shah I.
 
• **Bidar:** The smallest of the five kingdoms, known for its rich cultural heritage and the Bidar Fort.
 
• **Berar:** It was the last to emerge and was eventually annexed by the Ahmadnagar Sultanate.
